title: How To Find the Best Private Drug Detox
h1: How To Find the Best Private Drug Detox
metaDescription: Knowing your end goal can help you select a private drug detox that matches up best with your recovery needs. We can provide you with a structured, supportive environment to enable you to create life in long-term recovery. Learn more!

blocks.text: Once you decide to get sober, the subsequent decisions are all about how and where. The good news is that there is no shortage of options, but that can feel overwhelming. If you’ve reached the end of your rope with your drugs and alcohol, you may have consequences piling up all around you. Making decisions in the midst of it all may be difficult, but know that you can always adjust your course as you progress in your sobriety. Because addiction is much more researched and understood, there are options including peer support recovery groups, private drug detox, inpatient treatment, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and more.

At Marina Harbor Detox, we understand how challenging it can feel to decide where and how to get sober. Our professional and compassionate staff will partner with you to create an individualized treatment plan that starts your recovery journey in a safe and supportive environment.

Private drug detox is a detox that is completed within a private facility. Typically these facilities will be smaller with a lower staff-to-patient ratio. The cost of private drug detox is often covered by your health insurance or paid privately. Set up more like a 5-star hotel than a hospital, our facility offers beautiful San Francisco Bay Area views. We strive to provide a warm, supportive homelike environment to provide you with a peaceful and serene beginning for your recovery. Drug detox isn’t easy, but starting in a beautiful environment can help. A private facility will often have more to offer in terms of supportive therapies, activities, and comfort. At our private drug detox, we understand that you are a unique individual, and we begin with a personalized treatment plan that focuses on you. Your journey into addiction and recovery is personal to you. We are here to support you in the way you need to set you up for a lifetime of sobriety.
How To Find the Best Private Drug Detox

As you look at the options available to you, you’ll want to start by thinking about what you want your life in recovery to look like. Knowing the end goal can help you to select a private drug detox that matches up best. Next, you’ll want to talk to the different facilities to find out what they offer. We offer alcohol detox, drug detox, suboxone detox, and NAD (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) therapy at our private drug detox. We also provide a range of holistic therapies to heal your mind, body, and spirit. By blending traditional detox methods with healing practices such as Reiki healing, we address the physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery. We understand that recovery involves more than detox, and we’re here to support you from start to finish. While treatment does and must begin with ridding the body of drugs and alcohol, detox truly is only the beginning. Years of drug and alcohol use have taken their toll on every part of you, and we know how to help you begin healing it all.

Breaking free from addiction can seem like a frightening proposition, but you don’t have to do it on your own. At Marina Harbor Detox, our team of medical professionals understands what it takes to recover from addiction. We provide a luxurious, intimate setting that relies on individualized care and a low patient-to-staff ratio. In addition, we will provide you with a structured, supportive environment to enable you to create life in long-term recovery. Contact us today to start your recovery journey.
